The diagnostic differences between fibrocystic change and other candidate diseases, such as ductal carcinoma in situ and microinvasive ductal carcinoma, include mammographic appearance, histologic examination findings, and clinical presentation.

The diagnostic differences between ductal carcinoma in situ and other candidate diseases, such as fibrocystic change and microinvasive ductal carcinoma, include size of the lesion, presence of invasion, and mammographic appearance.
